description: New trade numbers out of an APEC meeting in China show the country's business with member economies is growing faster than the country's overall foreign trade (01:16). The Iranian president says the country is in a full-scale war with its enemies on all fronts, after Washington threatened crippling economic action against Tehran (09:33). Authorities say China captured half of the global humanoid robot market in 2025, with the sector generating over 1.3 billion US dollars in revenue (37:21).
classificationReason: A substantial segment reports on China’s humanoid-robot market share, innovation, and sector revenue, alongside unrelated news.
